title: What Is Variolation?
description:
Variolation was the risky way to fight smallpox before vaccines: doctors took a little matter from a smallpox sore and scratched it into a healthy person's arm. It usually gave a milder illness and lifelong protection, but some people died from it, and they could pass full smallpox on to others.

Full film:
